name: license_status
description: Show whether this server runs in free or Pro mode and where to upgrade.

name: license_activate
description: Activate a Pro license key (format MCPL1.xxx.yyy). Verified offline and saved locally.

arguments.name: key
arguments.desc: License key from the checkout confirmation page

name: qr_create
description: Call this tool to turn text or a URL into a QR code, as an SVG returned inline or written to out_path, or as a PNG at a chosen pixel size (Pro).

arguments.name: text
arguments.desc: The text or URL the code carries

arguments.name: error_correction
arguments.desc: L 7%, M 15% (default), Q 25%, H 30% of the code recoverable when damaged

arguments.name: size
arguments.desc: PNG width in pixels, 32 to 4000 (default 300). SVG scales without it

arguments.name: margin
arguments.desc: Quiet zone in modules, default 4, which is what the QR standard requires

arguments.name: format
arguments.desc: svg (default, free) or png (Pro)

arguments.name: out_path
arguments.desc: Where to write the file. SVG is returned inline when this is left out; PNG always needs it

arguments.name: overwrite
arguments.desc: Replace out_path if it already exists (default false)

name: qr_wifi
description: Call this tool to make a QR code that joins a WiFi network when scanned: network name, password and security type, written to out_path or returned as SVG.

arguments.name: ssid
arguments.desc: Network name, exactly as it appears

arguments.name: password
arguments.desc: Passphrase. Leave out only for an open network

arguments.name: auth
arguments.desc: WPA (default when a password is given), WEP, or nopass for an open network

arguments.name: hidden
arguments.desc: True if the network does not broadcast its name

arguments.name: error_correction
arguments.desc: L 7%, M 15% (default), Q 25%, H 30% of the code recoverable when damaged

arguments.name: size
arguments.desc: PNG width in pixels, 32 to 4000 (default 300). SVG scales without it

arguments.name: margin
arguments.desc: Quiet zone in modules, default 4, which is what the QR standard requires

arguments.name: format
arguments.desc: svg (default, free) or png (Pro)

arguments.name: out_path
arguments.desc: Where to write the file. SVG is returned inline when this is left out; PNG always needs it

arguments.name: overwrite
arguments.desc: Replace out_path if it already exists (default false)

name: qr_vcard
description: Call this tool to make a QR code that adds a contact when scanned (vCard 3.0: name, org, phone, email, URL, address), written to out_path or returned as SVG.

arguments.name: name
arguments.desc: Full name, for example Anna Kowalska

arguments.name: org
arguments.desc: Company or organisation

arguments.name: title
arguments.desc: Job title

arguments.name: phone
arguments.desc: Phone number, in the form it should be dialled

arguments.name: email
arguments.desc: Email address

arguments.name: url
arguments.desc: Website

arguments.name: address
arguments.desc: Postal address, one line

arguments.name: note
arguments.desc: Free note stored on the contact

arguments.name: error_correction
arguments.desc: L 7%, M 15% (default), Q 25%, H 30% of the code recoverable when damaged

arguments.name: size
arguments.desc: PNG width in pixels, 32 to 4000 (default 300). SVG scales without it

arguments.name: margin
arguments.desc: Quiet zone in modules, default 4, which is what the QR standard requires

arguments.name: format
arguments.desc: svg (default, free) or png (Pro)

arguments.name: out_path
arguments.desc: Where to write the file. SVG is returned inline when this is left out; PNG always needs it

arguments.name: overwrite
arguments.desc: Replace out_path if it already exists (default false)

name: qr_payment_sepa
description: Call this tool to make an EPC069-12 payment QR code a euro banking app can scan: IBAN, beneficiary name, optional amount and reference. The IBAN is checked before drawing.

arguments.name: iban
arguments.desc: Beneficiary IBAN. Checked with ISO 7064 mod 97 and refused if it does not validate

arguments.name: name
arguments.desc: Beneficiary name, up to 70 characters

arguments.name: amount
arguments.desc: Amount in EUR, 0.01 to 999999999.99. Leave out and the payer types it

arguments.name: currency
arguments.desc: EUR only; any other value is refused, because EPC encodes a SEPA credit transfer

arguments.name: bic
arguments.desc: Beneficiary BIC. Optional under EPC version 002

arguments.name: remittance
arguments.desc: Free payment text, up to 140 characters, for example an invoice number

arguments.name: reference
arguments.desc: Structured creditor reference (RF...), up to 35. Use this OR remittance, never both

arguments.name: purpose
arguments.desc: Four-letter ISO 20022 purpose code, for example GDDS

arguments.name: error_correction
arguments.desc: L 7%, M 15% (default), Q 25%, H 30% of the code recoverable when damaged

arguments.name: size
arguments.desc: PNG width in pixels, 32 to 4000 (default 300). SVG scales without it

arguments.name: margin
arguments.desc: Quiet zone in modules, default 4, which is what the QR standard requires

arguments.name: format
arguments.desc: svg (default, free) or png (Pro)

arguments.name: out_path
arguments.desc: Where to write the file. SVG is returned inline when this is left out; PNG always needs it

arguments.name: overwrite
arguments.desc: Replace out_path if it already exists (default false)

name: invoice_payment_qr
description: Call this tool to make the payment QR code for an invoice: your IBAN and name come from the shared business profile, the amount and reference from invoice_id or from the arguments.

arguments.name: invoice_id
arguments.desc: Invoice number, for example INV-2026-0007. Read from the invoice server's store if it is present

arguments.name: amount
arguments.desc: Amount in EUR. Overrides the invoice total; required when there is no invoice to read

arguments.name: reference
arguments.desc: Payment text, up to 140 characters. Defaults to the invoice number

arguments.name: iban
arguments.desc: Override the IBAN in the shared business profile

arguments.name: name
arguments.desc: Override the beneficiary name in the shared business profile

arguments.name: error_correction
arguments.desc: L 7%, M 15% (default), Q 25%, H 30% of the code recoverable when damaged

arguments.name: size
arguments.desc: PNG width in pixels, 32 to 4000 (default 300). SVG scales without it

arguments.name: margin
arguments.desc: Quiet zone in modules, default 4, which is what the QR standard requires

arguments.name: format
arguments.desc: svg (default, free) or png (Pro)

arguments.name: out_path
arguments.desc: Where to write the file. SVG is returned inline when this is left out; PNG always needs it

arguments.name: overwrite
arguments.desc: Replace out_path if it already exists (default false)

name: barcode_create
description: Call this tool to draw a linear barcode (code128, ean13, ean8, upca) as SVG or PNG. A short EAN or UPC gets its check digit computed; a wrong one is refused, never redrawn.

arguments.name: symbology
arguments.desc: code128 for any printable ASCII, ean13 and ean8 for retail products, upca for North American retail

arguments.name: value
arguments.desc: The data to encode. Digits only for EAN and UPC

arguments.name: module_width
arguments.desc: Width of the narrowest bar, in pixels or SVG units (default 2)

arguments.name: height
arguments.desc: Bar height in the same units (default 80)

arguments.name: text
arguments.desc: Print the digits under the bars (default true)

arguments.name: format
arguments.desc: svg (default, free) or png (Pro)

arguments.name: out_path
arguments.desc: Where to write the file. SVG is returned inline when this is left out; PNG always needs it

arguments.name: overwrite
arguments.desc: Replace out_path if it already exists (default false)

name: barcode_batch
description: Call this tool to draw many barcodes or QR codes at once from a list of rows, each with its own value and file name, into out_dir. Pro; the free tier does one code per call.

arguments.name: out_dir
arguments.desc: Existing directory the files are written into

arguments.name: items
arguments.desc: The rows to draw

arguments.name: symbology
arguments.desc: Default symbology for rows that do not name one (default code128)

arguments.name: stop_on_error
arguments.desc: Stop at the first bad row instead of drawing the rest and reporting it (default false)

arguments.name: module_width
arguments.desc: Width of the narrowest bar, in pixels or SVG units (default 2)

arguments.name: height
arguments.desc: Bar height in the same units (default 80)

arguments.name: text
arguments.desc: Print the digits under the bars (default true)

arguments.name: format
arguments.desc: svg (default, free) or png (Pro)

arguments.name: out_path
arguments.desc: Where to write the file. SVG is returned inline when this is left out; PNG always needs it

arguments.name: overwrite
arguments.desc: Replace out_path if it already exists (default false)

name: code_list
description: List the codes this server generated, newest first, with what each one carried and where it was written, plus how many of this month's free allowance are left.

arguments.name: limit
arguments.desc: How many rows to show, newest first (default 20)

arguments.name: kind
arguments.desc: Only rows of this kind: text, wifi, vcard, sepa, invoice, barcode or batch
